summary: Wrote a 6-phase, 10-hour implementation plan for the /slice build: series-file schema plus script skeleton, check and the static no-push/no-forge assertion (Phase 1); the build subcommand's fresh overlay/write-tree/commit-tree/compare-and-swap primitive (Phase 2); status, the union check and two further static assertions (Phase 3); commands/slice.md's whole command surface including the forge call (Phase 4); registration plus the runtime-file row (Phase 5); redeploy, scoped verification and the operator handoff with the record left open (Phase 6). Territory is 8 source-store files plus the __WHOLE_TREE__ redeploy claim -- three more than the dispatch listed, because the doc lint mechanically requires a README.md row for a manifest-declared command and because the plan decided yes on the deferred orchestrator-runtime-files.md row (which drags in its coupled index-entries.json line count). validate-artifact.sh reports PASS with 0 warnings.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan for the /slice script, series file, command file, suite, registration and redeploy, stopping short of the operator-only push and pull-request step.
